name: Leather mate cup and bombilla set
where: Craft shops at the San Telmo Sunday market
about: A mate cup is a hollowed gourd or leather-covered vessel used to drink yerba mate, Argentina's traditional herbal tea. Buenos Aires shares this ritual with the whole country, so the set is a classic local keepsake.
tip: Prices are quoted in US dollars because the local currency changes value quickly, so set your budget in USD.

name: Alfajores
about: Alfajores are soft shortbread cookies filled with dulce de leche, a caramel-like milk spread. They are one of the most popular sweets in Argentina and a common gift to bring home.
tip: Plan your budget in US dollars, since local prices can shift quickly.
